title: Cross-Product Guidance — The Attributed Share of a Measured Saving, Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# The Attributed Share of a Measured Saving

Guidance on the share of a measured saving attributed to the company when savings are verified under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions, where the same building also holds an agreement under Preventive Maintenance Agreements. The unmaintained share is 65 percent, the part maintained share 82 percent, and the whole of the measured saving 100 percent.

## Rule

Where the building holds no preventive maintenance agreement in active or renewal standing, the attributed share is the unmaintained share, because the plant the saving is measured on is not being kept to its programme. Where the building holds such an agreement and the repair allowance standing on it for the year is exhausted, the attributed share is the part maintained share. In every other case the attributed share is the whole of the measured saving.

## What decides it

Two figures are read from the agreement the building holds under Preventive Maintenance Agreements: its standing, and the repair allowance still standing on it for the year.

| Agreement at the building | Repair allowance standing for the year | Attributed share |
|---|---|---|
| none, or in any standing other than active or pending renewal | any | 65 percent |
| active or pending renewal | exhausted — nothing or less remains | 82 percent |
| active or pending renewal | an amount still stands | 100 percent |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A building whose maintenance agreement stands active with USD 1 800.00 of repair allowance left carries the whole of the measured saving at 100 percent. Were that allowance drawn to nothing, the share would be 82 percent; were the agreement suspended, cancelled or absent altogether, 65 percent.
